sources.snippet: Benefits At the time of release, this family of models provides high-performance open vision-language model implementations designed from the ground up for responsible AI development compared to similarly sized models.

sources.title: unsloth/gemma-4-12b-it-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Gemma is a family of open models built by Google DeepMind. Gemma 4 models are multimodal, handling text and image input (with audio supported on E2B, E4B, and 12B) and generating text output. This release includes open-weights models in both pre-trained and instruction-tuned variants.

sources.title: Gemma 4 - How to Run Locally | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: Then go to the Unsloth Chat tab and search for Gemma 4 in the search bar and download your desired model and quant. Unsloth supports the latest Gemma-4-12B Unified model.

sources.title: Gemma 4 QAT | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: Run Google Gemma 4 QAT models locally, including E2B, E4B, 12B, 26B-A4B, and 31B.

sources.snippet: Overview gemma-4-12B-it-qat-q4_0-gguf is a 12-billion parameter instruction-tuned multimodal language model built by google and released under the Apache 2.0 license. This specific variant uses Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) with Q4_0 quantization to preserve near-bfloat16 quality while dramatically reducing memory requirements for deployment.
